label: PF Backlog 582
title: Eventing SSOT: Python thin-client cutover of core/events.py over the A1 wire seam (edit-only)
body:
## Problem / why
PY emitters currently write the stream directly; the Go core will own emit/seq. Must cut over with zero
consumer changes.

## Goal / value
core/events.py (edit-only, no new module) delegates emit to the Go core via core/go_host while keeping its
public API and envelope back-compat; reads remain compatible.

## In scope
- Edit core/events.py + core/contracts seam; keep TYPES/EVENT_VERSION/emit/read/counts signatures.
- Feature-flag/strangler: fall back to existing writer if Go host unavailable (fail-safe, not fail-open).

## Out of scope
- New Python modules; changing emit signatures.

## Acceptance criteria
- All 50 events consumers unchanged; test_api_events + test_event_ssot green; no duplicate store.

## Verification / test plan
- Contract test pins public symbols; run event/test suite + precheck.

## Dependencies & links
- E2, E3.
